tool.name: ParaFEM Transient Thermal Solver
tool.description: Solve 3D transient heat conduction using ParaFEM p124 (implicit theta + PCG solver)

param.name: d_file
param.label: Mesh geometry (.d)
param.help: Mesh file with nodal coordinates and element connectivity

param.name: fix_file
param.label: Fixed freedoms (.fix)
param.help: Prescribed temperature values from BC generator

param.name: dat_file
param.label: Control data (.dat)
param.help: Solver control parameters from BC generator

param.name: mat_file
param.label: Material properties (.mat)
param.help: Material thermal properties (kx, ky, kz, rho, cp) from BC generator

tool.help:
Solves 3D transient heat conduction using ParaFEM program p124.
Solver: Implicit theta time integration with Preconditioned Conjugate Gradient (PCG) for the spatial solve at each time step. Uses 8-node hexahedral elements.
Time integration schemes (set via theta in the .dat file): - theta=0.5: Crank-Nicolson (second-order accurate) - theta=1.0: Fully implicit/backward Euler (unconditionally stable)
Boundary conditions: Dirichlet (fixed temperature) via the penalty method. Material properties (conductivity, density, specific heat) are read from the .mat file.
Outputs: - .res: text summary with time, temperature at monitor node, and PCG iterations per step - .ensi.tar.gz: EnSight Gold scalar fields (NDTTR-NNNNNN) for each output timestep
Pass the .ensi.tar.gz to the ParaFEM to VTU Converter for ParaView visualization. The number of MPI processes is controlled by GALAXY_SLOTS.
